identification: Framed 1920s coloured print of the interior of Westminster Abbey with crowds at the grave of the Unknown Warrior (Union Jack and wreaths, candles, Nov 1920 scene). Described as signed in pencil by the artist, H38 x W26 cm. Artist not legible in photos (tiny pencil signature bottom right, caption bottom left). Gilt frame, buff mount.
marks_seen: Caption line under the print bottom left (illegible at this resolution), pencil signature bottom right (illegible). No publisher mark visible.

Only found Frank Salisbury paintings and photo postcards; could not identify the artist.

identification: Vintage West German glazed ceramic Christmas tree stand, white glaze with embossed stars and vertical ribbing, black metal clamp ring with four brass eye-bolts for the trunk, holds water. Base marked W-GERMANY, 343-26 and a three-circle impressed mark. This style is made by Jasba Keramik (also similar by Scheurich); maker not confirmed from the base marks. White is less common than the usual green.
